overview: The Medford School Committee approved a $653,933.55 budget transfer and exceptions to its natural gas equipment ban, and received presentations on a high school mural project and the district's 2026 state accountability results.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved the consent agenda, which included meeting minutes, donations to the high school and middle school Best Buddies chapters, and a budget transfer of $653,933.55 to fund new summer school and security overtime accounts.

items.title: Mustang Moment: "At Our Core" Mural Presentation
items.summary: Fine and Performing Arts Director Suzanne Fee and student artists presented on the design and installation of a new five-panel hallway mural titled "At Our Core" at Medford High School.

items.title: State Accountability and Academic Testing Results
items.summary: Assistant Superintendent Dr. Kim Talbot presented part one of the district's 2026 state accountability data, highlighting Medford's rise to the 50th percentile and its progress in boosting advanced coursework enrollment among low-income students.

items.title: Natural Gas Powered Equipment Replacement Request
items.summary: Approved a request to purchase natural gas powered equipment for school kitchens and hot water systems as an exception to the committee's 2024 ban, with an amendment directing the administration to reuse the replaced high school stove elsewhere.

items.title: Student Advisory Council Presentation
items.summary: Tabled the Student Advisory Council presentation until the next meeting.

items.title: Condolences
items.summary: Expressed condolences to the families of Ralph E. Giddings, Jr., Caroline Luciano Labbadini, and John Bud Bissell, Sr.
